name: WOOD, the Hon. Jason Peter

headline.note: Two separate Victoria Police periods are evidenced, including a return between parliamentary terms. Exact boundaries, full-time status, leave and2001break remain unresolved; early outdoor work also incomplete. Totals remainnull.

career_spells.role: Police officer; detective, Organised Crime Squad; senior sergeant, Counter Terrorism Coordination Unit
career_spells.evidence_note: Official sources place police service within 1988–2004, detective work in 1990–2000 and senior sergeant work in 2003–2004. These are nested roles, not additive spells. A historical campaign page says he resigned for the 2001 election; reinstatement date and break length are unknown, so this enclosing interval does not assert continuous employment. Full-time status is unverified. Maiden speech dates sergeant promotion to1997 and senior-sergeant promotion to2003, resolving the less reliable campaign-page2006claim. The later18-year recollection is inconsistent with enclosing1988–2004andABC13years; not accepted as duration.
career_spells.counting_note: Dates, employer control and/or substantive full-time status remain insufficient for a duration calculation; unknown is not zero.

career_spells.role: Master of Applied Science study; counter-terrorism specialisation

research_notes: Follow up Victoria Police appointment, resignation, reinstatement and leave records, especially the stated 2001 resignation; verify substantive full-time service, precise boundaries, early school-camp employer and all paid work during 2010–2013.

The 1988–2004 interval is an enclosing career range, not 16 countable full-time years. ABC's 13-year description and the 2001 resignation suggest a break requiring documentary resolution. Do not silently reconcile them by inventing dates.

Historical campaign page gives 2006 for a police promotion despite parliamentary service commencing in 2004; this is retained as an unresolved source discrepancy, not adopted as a job boundary. Its attribution and early camp claim need stronger archival corroboration.

Searched official parliamentary and ministerial biographies, Victoria Police employer material, 2013 election reporting, historical campaign biography, public professional-profile results and 2010–2013 employment terms. Namesake results and another ABC candidate's IT consultancy were excluded. No reliable full-time or gap-employment evidence was retrieved.

Potential follow-up: National Library archived campaign site catalogue nla.arc-79223 and original first speech; archive content not yet retrieved. Last follow-up 2026-09-29. Political appointments, party candidacy and community activities do not prove qualifying paid employment.

2026-10-02 follow-up read the complete2013speech career paragraph, establishing a previously omitted return to Victoria Police after2010defeat. Added separate undated spell bounded narratively by parliamentary terms. Authorised2004maiden speech confirms early outdoor instruction,1997sergeant promotion and2003masters completion/senior-sergeant promotion.

Prior initial pass inspected only opening of2013speech; this follow-up corrects that evidence gap without discarding prior sources. Eighteen-year police recollection differs from official1988–2004andABC13-year account;2001resignation and reinstatement still need primary service evidence. Neither title nor policing duties prove substantive full-time status.

Targeted2011police/2010–13work and university searches produced namesakes and duplicate summaries, no exact return dates or hours. APH search returned robots restriction; accessible authorised speech used. Next leads: Victoria Police service/appointment material and thesis catalogue; early school-camp employer stillunknown. Last follow-up2026-10-02; blocked retained.

2026-10-03 follow-up: current official parliamentary biography resolves the previously unidentified education provider as RMIT University and distinguishes the Graduate Diploma in Innovation Service Management from the Master of Applied Science. The authorised maiden speech supplies the2003 master's completion and counter-terrorism specialisation; no study start, attendance mode or leave is inferred. Fresh Victoria Police return-service, thesis-catalogue and camp-employer searches produced no reliable appointment or hours evidence. Material education-identity enrichment only; employment totals remain null and the record blocked.

2026-10-04 follow-up: narrow Victoria Police return-service and school-camp searches again located the 2013 first-person statement that he was invited back after the 2010 defeat and a self-description of two years' camp work before police academy graduation. Neither supplies return/cessation dates, hours, leave, the 2001 break, camp employer or pay basis; no Victoria Police personnel/appointment record surfaced. Repeating generic web searches is exhausted. Decisive evidence remains Victoria Police service records and contemporaneous camp-employer material. Record remains blocked.

Follow-up2026-10-04: Targeted part-time police and diploma queries produced derivative summaries or namesakes in US automotive work and Canadian theological study; none supplied his hours, reinstatement, resignation or qualification boundaries. Clarified existing evidence:2003 completion belongs to master’s, not automatically the separately listed RMIT diploma; diploma retains unknown dates. Early camp employer,2001break and inter-parliamentary police boundaries remain unresolved. Next targeted evidence: Victoria Police service and leave instruments, diploma conferral and contemporaneous outdoor-employer records. No new substantive fact adopted.
